LESSON: CONSUMER EDUCATION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE
Strand: Home Management
Topic 2.6: Consumer Education
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Consumer Education, part of Home Management in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How is knowledge on consumer education applied in life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the importance of consumer education in day- to-day life. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views on causes of accidents,

2. search for information from print and digital media on aspects of consumer awareness in consumer education, (consumer rights and responsibilities, sources of consumer information, wise buying of goods and services). Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolutions could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the importance of consumer education in day- to-day life. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views on causes of accidents,
2. search for information from print and digital media on aspects of consumer awareness in consumer education, (consumer rights and responsibilities, sources of consumer information, wise buying of goods and services). Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolutions could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Consumer Education together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner exhibits confidence when role playing aspects of consumer education.

● Learning to Learn: The learner organises their own learning as they search for information on aspects of consumer

awareness in consumer education.

Values:
● Unity: Learner displays team spirit as they role play on aspects of consumer education.

34

● Respect: Learners appreciate diverse opinions when discussing the importance of consumer education.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial Literacy: Learners are made aware of the principles of wise buying and how to apply them in day-to day life.

Suggested learning resources:

Adapted digital devices and print reference materials,
